messages:
ari (product): Drafting a "rechargeable burst band" concept for reserved pools. Key idea: daily credit band that can roll over a limited amount to the next day, plus adaptive replenish if overall region usage low. Want productization notes + launch guardrails.

sam (eng-runtime): rollovers make accounting trickier but doable. we can cap rollover to 20% of daily band to avoid debt. will need a nightly settle job and idempotent ledger ops. also consider per-tenant burn rate smoothing to avoid one tenant draining others instantly.

priya (eng-sre): safety rules first: preemption order table, emergency drain, and explicit tolerance for degraded p99 during recovery windows. require synthetic slack monitor that triggers when rollover usage > 50% of pool for 3 consecutive hours.

lee (data): from telemetry POV we'll need new timeseries: daily_credit_allocated, credit_used, credit_rolled_over, peak_hour_burn, minutes_in_preempt. will build a heatmap to recommend default band sizes after pilot.

jamal (sales): customers asked for rollover semantics. major ask: guarantee X seconds of low-latency during a surge, but they accept preemption afterwards. pricing asks: flat monthly for band + per-token overage, or burst-only metering. we should test both.

ari (product): UX: pool settings: band_size, rollover_percent, replenish_window, preempt_priority (enum), opt-in checkbox. also show historical "burst availability" chart in console so customers can audit usage.

sam (eng-runtime): sketch config block:
```
burst_band:
  daily_tokens: 500k
  rollover_pct: 20
  replenish_time: "02:30 UTC"
  adaptive_replenish: true
  min_replenish_threshold: 0.15
```
adaptive_replenish will top up bands if region idle < 30% for 2 hours. reduces wasted capacity.

priya (eng-sre): launch checklist suggestion:
- pilot tenants: 3 customers across different workload shapes (chat short-turn, enterprise batching, long-context agents)
- pilot length: 21 days with daily audit
- SLOs: burst p95 <= baseline p95 + 20ms, burst p99 increase capped at 10% relative
- telemetry: as lee listed + preemptation incidents log
- rollback: auto-disable per-region when preempt incidents > 0.4% for 6h
- ops runbook: steps to quarantine tenant, revoking rollover, and emergency-disable for region

jamal (sales): i'll recruit pilot customers. can we provide two sample contract clauses: one with rollover enabled, one without? clients want clear breach terms.

lee (data): i'll run a historical sim on last 90 days to estimate expected monthly burn distribution and recommend three default tiers (small/medium/large). need the pilot to validate tail behavior though.

sam (eng-runtime): estimate work: ledger + scheduler changes (2 sprints), adaptive replenish logic + testing (1 sprint), metrics + dashboard (1 sprint). total ~4 sprints with eng-runtime + eng-infra + data.

priya (eng-sre): testing: add chaos test that preempts top-burn tenant and verify failover ordering. also schedule a soak for 72h under pilot.

ari (product): owners and timeline: sam proto due in 3 weeks, lee to deliver tier recommendations in 2 weeks, priya to own SLOs and runbook by end of sprint, jamal to draft contract options. target pilot kickoff in 5 weeks. GA tentative in 12 weeks if pilot meets criteria.

ops-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/docs/rechargeable-burst-band-rfc (access: product, eng-runtime, eng-sre, data).

ari (product): sounds good. one more ask: include pricing experiment A/B doc (flat vs usage) and a short FAQ for sales to present to pilots. i'll consolidate and share the checklist Monday. :spiral_calendar: :white_check_mark:

sam (eng-runtime): ack. starting prototype ticket today.

priya (eng-sre): ack. I'll draft alerts and the evacuation runbook.

jamal (sales): ack, will line up pilot customers and contract drafts.
